name: omnidraw-workspace
description: Run your agents in an infinite canvas

scripts.test: bun run test:typecheck && bun run test:workspace && bun run test:architecture && bun run test:source-run-build-stability && bun run test:conformance && bun run test:db && bun run test:packed-public-composition && bun run test:browser
scripts.test:architecture: bun test --isolate scripts/public-packages.test.ts scripts/architecture-boundaries.test.ts scripts/cangine-qualification.test.ts scripts/source-release-policy.test.ts scripts/prepare-package-dist.test.ts scripts/verify-package-dists.test.ts scripts/list-package-deployments.test.ts
scripts.test:conformance: bun run scripts/generate-private-operation-manifest.ts && bun test --parallel=2 --isolate tests/transport && bun run test:backend:conformance && bun run test:frontend:conformance
scripts.test:db: bun run db:schema:verify && bun run db:constraints:test && bun run db:recovery:test
scripts.test:packed-public-composition: bun run scripts/test-packed-public-composition.ts && bun run scripts/test-packed-sdk-offline-check.ts
scripts.test:browser: bun run test:browser:typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/frontend build && bun run scripts/seal-source-release-build.ts && bun run scripts/test-preview-inspection-built-shell.ts && bun run scripts/test-packed-canvas.ts && bun run test:browser:live
scripts.build: bun run build:public && bun run --sequential --filter '@omnidraw/backend' --filter '@omnidraw/frontend' build && bun run scripts/seal-source-release-build.ts
scripts.build:public: bun run --cwd packages/theme build && bun run --cwd packages/canvas-contract build && bun run --cwd packages/sdk build && bun run --cwd packages/canvas build && bun run --cwd packages/component-ai-chat build
scripts.predev: bun run build:public && bun run build:inspection
scripts.preclient:dev: bun run build:public && bun run build:inspection
scripts.server:dev: cd apps/backend && NODE_ENV=development bun run --watch src/main.ts serve
